Product Details: Cleans & Protects All-in-One: Formula 1 High-Performance Protectant is an effective exterior and interior car cleaner to help renew your car shine and color while protecting all types of surfaces: rubber, vinyl, leather, and plastic. With this UV protectant spray, you no longer need to switch between cleaning products. Lustrous Shine: The advanced silicone technology of Formula 1 car interior protectant leaves a beautiful shine behind as it has just come out of the car wash! This car cleaner spray removes dirt and dust and acts as a protective layer against dulling, fading, and cracking, with no oily residue. Multi-Purpose Use: Make all your car accessories look new with our car cleaner interior and exterior protectant. It’s very effective as a leather seating, vinyl covers, tires, and dashboard cleaner, creating a shield against sun damaging UV rays. With Formula 1 Protectant spray, there’s no need to buy different car care products to keep your vehicle at its greatest. New Car Smell: This car protectant spray also has a pleasant fragrance to keep your vehicle smelling as great as it looks. You can use it along with your favorite air freshener car device or just enjoy its refreshing car scent. Easy to Apply: Our car shine spray makes your life simpler. Just shake the interior car cleaner bottle and apply it directly onto the surface, or on a clean cloth, and rub. Let it absorb and wipe the excess off. You may reapply this vehicle interior cleaner as many times as you wish. Made in USA
